name: New Zombie Shelter
tagline: Gather wood and steel by day, build and defend your shelter by night, and survive 30 days of the dead.
summary: New Zombie Shelter replaces the original Zombie Shelter with a team-oriented base-building survival mode. Squads harvest wood and steel, craft weapons at a worktable, unlock four tiers of shelter structures (towers, fences, generators, turrets) and spend skill points across Combat, Survival and Engineer trees while zombies attack every night. Co-op teams must kill the final boss or call in a rescue within 30 days; Team Match pits two shelters against each other.
description: The wiki describes New Zombie Shelter as a complete expansion of the old Zombie Shelter with more features and mechanics: where the old mode was simply PvPvE with a shelter per player, the new one has two variations - Team Match and Co-op - and is teamwork-oriented, with each team caring for one shared shelter. The Hammer was removed and the Shelter Axe tweaked so one slash reaps one unit of a resource; the Jungle Knife yields two resources per hit and a crowbar variant four. Primary resources are wood and steel, with electricity powering defences; storage buildings raise the resource cap. The Worktable (requires Beginner Engineer) crafts items such as the Machete, USP45, crowbar and claw hammer. Structures unlock by shelter tier: Tier 1 observation post, barbed-wire fence and gate, alarm, mines, gun tower, small generator; Tier 2 reconnaissance guard post, enhanced fencing, thorn trap, flamethrower, communication tower, medium generator, liquid-nitrogen cylinder; Tier 3 enhanced gate, claymore, gatling tower, large generator; Tier 4 shop post, plasma turret, electronics tower, mega generator. Players gain 3 skill points on day 1 and 1 per day after, spent in Combat (gun mastery, ammo/health up, Bombing Request), Survival (harvest, speed, campfire, tracker, Cloak, resource transporting) and Engineer (engineer ranks, auto repair, recycle, Wrecking Team with C4, turret moving) trees. Building menu: B key; skill tree: N key. Firing recklessly raises a noise gauge that draws zombies; players who die at night spectate with night-vision goggles; buildings cannot be destroyed by players who join after day 5.
lore: No dedicated story section was captured. The setting is a zombie-overrun 'Dead City' (referenced in medal descriptions) where survivors build fortified shelters; the map City of Damned carries over from the old mode.
rules: Co-op: 4 players; win by annihilating the final target boss zombie or successfully requesting rescue; lose if the main shelter is destroyed or the boss is not beaten within 30 days.
Rescue: all personnel must request rescue and group up within 60 seconds; the request can be repeated after 60 seconds if aborted.
Team Match: 6+ players; destroy the enemy's main shelter to win; lose if yours is destroyed.
Day/night cycle: harvest and build by day, defend against escalating zombie waves each night.
Skill points: 3 on day 1, then 1 per day; three skill trees (Combat, Survival, Engineer).
Noise gauge: reckless gunfire attracts zombies.
trivia: The Shelter Tier 4 icon appeared before its update was released, reusing the old Zombie Shelter model.
After the Indonesian release, players were still given the old Zombie Shelter special missions by mistake, and the old City of Damned map remained playable.
Current maps have many structures that bosses can jump onto, making them hard to defeat.
A Cloak-skill glitch once allowed indefinite invisibility until patched.
Medals: [The Last Survivor] for 100 Co-op clears (4-player rooms) and a Team Match medal for 100 victories (6+ player rooms).
